scope: Read-only diagnosis of the existing scalar recipe and saved artifacts; no retraining or new inference.

recorded_value_context.description: Comment describes sector clamp as 4.5 percent of a 50 uT deployment field, and discusses INT8 resolution tradeoffs. This is recorded context, not independent validation of that engineering choice.

pid_contract.label: total vector magnitude
pid_contract.estimator: integer-bin two-minimum splitting proxy, or single-minimum displacement from fixed sweep midpoint
pid_contract.interpretation: Coarse sampling and a simple splitting proxy do not generally provide accurate total field magnitude for arbitrary orientations; separate causal contributions were not measured.

quantization.interpretation: Small measured quantization difference does not explain the large scalar total-field error.

conclusion: The recipe teaches bounded small corrections and removes correction magnitude for approximately 95 percent of training examples. Removing only the runtime clamp cannot restore information absent from the targets. Broader-target retraining has not been evaluated in this diagnostic; success is not established.
